meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 用户要求分析代码变更时,Claude 会先核对项目知识图谱是否存在,再对照图谱找出被改动的组件、可能受影响的组件与架构层,给出风险评估,并把结果写入一个 JSON 文件供可视化看板显示。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析 git diff 或 pull request,想弄清改了什么、哪些组件受影响以及有什么风险时。

say.text: 分析一下当前分支的代码改动
say.note: 会输出改动组件、受影响组件和风险分析。

say.text: 看看这个 PR 影响了哪些组件
say.note: 会读取 PR 的 diff 并对照知识图谱分析。

say.text: 对比 main 分支,我的改动有什么风险
say.note: 给出基于复杂度和影响范围的风险评估。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to analyze code changes, Claude first checks whether the project knowledge graph exists, then identifies changed components, potentially affected components and architectural layers from the graph, provides a risk assessment, and writes the result to a JSON file for the dashboard.
howto.when_en: When the user needs to analyze a git diff or pull request to understand what changed, affected components, and risks.

say_en.text: Analyze the code changes on the current branch.
say_en.note: It will produce a structured impact analysis.

say_en.text: Which components does this PR affect?
say_en.note: It reads the PR diff and checks the graph.

say_en.text: Compare with main and tell me the risks of my changes.
say_en.note: Risk assessment based on complexity and blast radius.
